text: {"lessons":["Recent price changes have not reliably predicted what comes next, so I should not trade on short-term moves.","Selling winners felt rewarding, but I should make buy and sell decisions using a consistent plan rather than the urge to lock in gains or avoid admitting a mistake.","My portfolio declined despite occasional sales; I should evaluate the whole account and make deliberate decisions instead of reacting to loss aversion or checking too infrequently."]}
